stem:
Anil talks about digestion of complex food components such as carbohydrates, proteins and fats. Food moves through the alimentary canal from mouth to anus. He also mentions the stomach and the absorption of nutrients into the blood.

Which statement correctly describes digestion?

options.text: Digestion joins simple food substances into complex substances the body can use.
Digestion is the breakdown of complex food components into simpler forms along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus.
All digestion takes place in the stomach.
Digestion is the absorption of nutrients into the blood.

teacher.key_rationale: Digestion breaks complex food into simpler forms along the alimentary canal from mouth to anus. It is not assembly, not stomach-only, and not the same as absorption.
